text:
Haruko: Flagging a timezone thing 11. We want to run the June webinar targeting APAC-friendly hours (EMEA too). Proposed time: Jun 23 08:00 PT / Jun 24 00:00 SGT. Will that work for speakers?
Diego: That time hits APAC morning and US late afternoon. I can do it but might need a short lunch overlap buffer.
Maya: I can present from Singapore office. Fine with the time.
Ethan: I have a customer in Seoul willing to join for 8-10 min vignette. Great fit.
Haruko: Nice. Core theme: "Serving inference across regions: latency, cost, and content compliance." Focus on multi-region routing + captions/localization.
Lina: Ops asks: we need captions in EN + JP + KO; vendor supports post-event translations for JP/KO but live captions only in EN. ops-bot confirmed?
ops-bot: Live English captions available in us-west-2 and ap-northeast-1. Post-event JP/KO auto-translations available for recordings.
Haruko: OK plan: Live EN captions; record event and create JP/KO transcripts within 48h. Add localized landing pages (EN/JP/KO) and route registrants accordingly.
Diego: I'll A/B test two email subject lines: (A) "Reduce inference spend without sacrificing latency" vs (B) "How product teams cut LLM costs while keeping SLAs". We'll measure open -> register.
Maya: Also test landing page hero copy: technical vs business angle. Two variants to match email group.
Haruko: Good. Routing: include a hidden field for locale and interest tag (product/infra/compliance). Use those tags for followup.
Ethan: Customer vignette: 8 min demo + 2 slides. I'll ask them to keep it high-level; they'll provide a 3-sentence blurb and logo by Jun 10.
Lina: Rehearsal windows: two green-room rehearsals (Jun 21 08:00 PT and Jun 22 23:00 PT). Which is preferable?
Maya: Prefer Jun 21 08:00 PT (earlier), but can do the 22nd if needed.
Diego: Add a separate APAC-friendly mic check 90 minutes before start for speakers in APAC.
Haruko: Deck owners: Diego draft hero + measurement slides; Maya runtime demo; Ethan customer slides; Haruko narrative + translations. Please drop decks in /marketing/shared/decks/jun23 by Jun 14.
design-bot: Reminder: hero image A/B sizes should be 1200x628 and localized images placed under /marketing/assets/jun23/locale/.
Haruko: Fallback plan: require 2-min pre-recorded clips for each live demo uploaded to s3://redwood-webinar/jun23/ by Jun 20. If caption vendor fails for JP/KO, we will upload translated SRTs with the recording.
Lina: Also ensure CDN purge rules for assets in APAC are tested. ops-bot can schedule purge test?
ops-bot: CDN purge test scheduled Jun 19 09:00 PT for ap-northeast-1 and ap-southeast-1.
Diego: For metrics, we'll track opens, regs, attendance by locale, and post-event engagement with localized playbooks. Also measure conversion by A/B subject line.
Maya: Speaker bios & 2-line abstracts due Jun 9. I'll paste mine here: "Maya — Staff Runtime Engineer, focuses on latency optimizations for production LLMs." Abstract: "Reducing cross-region latency via smart routing and model variants."
Ethan: My customer blurb will be up Jun 10.
Haruko: Final ask: please paste localized meta-description for landing pages (EN/JP/KO) and A/B subject lines by Jun 9 so we can hand to localization.
Diego: I'll post subject lines and page variants tomorrow.
Lina: Caption retention: keep original captions + translated SRTs for 365 days.
Haruko: Great work team. We'll lock run-of-show and rehearsal invites after bios land. :rocket:
